headline: Apple Reports Q4 Earnings Beat, Revenue Up 8% YoY
summary: Apple Inc reported better-than-expected fourth-quarter earnings with revenue reaching $89.5 billion, up 8% year-over-year. iPhone sales remained strong despite macroeconomic headwinds. Services revenue hit a record $22.3 billion. The company announced a $0.24 per share dividend and authorized a new $90 billion share buyback program.

headline: Tech Sector Volatility Expected Ahead of Fed Meeting
summary: Options traders are positioning for increased volatility in technology stocks ahead of next week's Federal Reserve policy meeting. Implied volatility for QQQ has risen to 22%, up from 18% last week. Analysts expect the Fed to maintain current rates but provide guidance on 2025 policy. Large tech names including AAPL, MSFT, and NVDA show elevated put activity.

headline: Microsoft Azure Cloud Revenue Accelerates to 29% Growth
summary: Microsoft's Azure cloud platform posted 29% revenue growth in the latest quarter, exceeding analyst expectations of 26%. The company's AI services integration is driving enterprise adoption. CEO Satya Nadella highlighted Azure's position in the AI infrastructure race. Commercial cloud revenue reached $31.8 billion, representing 55% of total revenue.
